{{Top|leg}}
'''Lozara''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Lozara commented on the [[disruption bubble generator]] entry in the Datalog, but noted they left a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] hole that was detectable if someone knew what to look for.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
